promotion_basis: Exact AArch64 instruction and relocation parity across the 588-byte ELF symbol, strict Ghidra C/P-Code comparison, strict Joern, reproducible Docker build, matching KCFI type ID and preamble, and passing host harness.
limitations: Offline/static evidence only; workqueue scheduling and hardware LED register behavior remain unverified on NX809J hardware/runtime.
The original C form emitted a different prologue, log literal surface, imax load sequence and symbol size; the versioned exact Assembly island preserves the stock body and KCFI preamble.
Sanitizers, register/bus ledger, state/effect ledger, semantic counterexample search and independent runtime review remain deferred.
